_readme: THE ACTION PIN REGISTER, read by tooling/ci/assert-workflow-hardening.mjs limb 15 and by nothing else.
One row per action path pinned by a `uses: owner/repo[/path]@<40-hex>` line in .github/workflows/*.yml or
.github/actions/*/action.yml. The limb holds it both ways: every pin has a row whose `sha` and `version` equal
the pin and its `# vX.Y.Z` comment, and every row names a pin the tree still has.
`using` is the action's own `runs.using` AT THAT SHA; it must be node24, composite or docker. It cannot be read
offline, so it is RECORDED here and is only as true as the read behind it: `readAt` is the date the runtime
was established AT THAT SHA (best: `gh api repos/<o>/<r>/contents/<path>/action.yml?ref=<sha>`), or null when
nobody has, and `source` says how. 🔴 WHEN A PIN MOVES (a Renovate `github actions` PR) ITS ROW MOVES IN THE SAME PR, AND
`using` IS RE-READ AT THE NEW SHA, never carried over: a new major is exactly where a runtime changes.

It wraps actions/attest@508db95d (v4.2.1) by its own SHA pin.
